title: Wait for confirmation
description: Do not enter before the setup confirms.

title: Use stop loss
description: Every trade must have a defined stop loss.

title: Max 2 trades
description: Do not exceed two trades in a trading day.

title: No FOMO
description: Do not chase an extended candle or missed entry.

title: Respect target/exit plan
description: Do not exit randomly before the planned target unless the setup invalidates.
